AdminStats.broyRazlichniUstroystvaBrauzari: The number of distinct devices or browsers that have ever visited the website. One person counts as one user, identified by a persistent localStorage token and a fingerprint.
AdminStats.kakavDyalOtUnikalnite: The percentage of unique users who have returned at least once (have more than one session). A high percentage indicates a loyal audience.
AdminStats.broyPoseshteniyaEdnaSesiya: The number of visits. One session is one visit to the website. If someone leaves and returns later, this counts as a new session.
AdminStats.srednoKolkoStranitsiRazglezhda: The average number of pages viewed by a visitor in one session and the time they spend on the website.
AdminStats.potrebiteliChietoParvoV: Users whose first-ever visit is today. Returning visitors are excluded, even if this is their first visit of the day.
AdminStats.obshtBroyPoseshteniyaZapochnali: The total number of visits started today since 00:00. Includes both new and returning users.
AdminStats.obshtBroySesiiZa: The total number of sessions over the past week. Useful for a quick overview of weekly traffic.
